notes.title: Full Release (0.6.0 -> 1.0.0)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022620/a114c26d98f1f0876089ee9ddb768760c20757f7.png[/img]

I've been patching the game for a couple of months and I tried to wait for a while to see if there is any change but the reality is nothing is changing. 

You might have heard a developer saying he is stopping support for his game because it didn't reach certain targets. In my case, the game is just dead. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022620/fa70325862759a6adfccf5fb4a2da9b76d07b3c2.png[/img]

For this reason, as much as it hurts me, I have decided to publish the last update (0.6.0) and launch the game into full release within the next few days (February 18th), with a 40% discount. 

I may have not added all the things that I wanted to add but the game has enough content to play for many hours (there is someone who crossed the 100+ hours). 

I want to thank everyone who gave feedback during the early access phase, your help was definitely valuable. 

Thanks,
NourSaiFR

notes.title: Weekly Patch 5: Score System V2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022620/0995dd0a172fc33960fd2faa89468ace306c9c8a.png[/img]

I had some issues yesterday so I had to delay this patch by 1 day. This patch is about bug fixes and adding some QOLs. This patch was all about feedback I got on Discord so there is 0 new content this time. 

[h1]New Score System[/h1]
There were some problems with the previous score system. The first one being that the values weren't saved so everything resets every time you load an existing run. The second issue was the lack of info related to the final score. Now there is a UI in the codex showing the score details. 

[h1]Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] [FIX]: Fixed an issue where the god mode level can be set to level 1 even when the player hasn't unlocked the level 1 yet.
[*] [FIX]: Fixed an issue where the next god mode level unlocked even when losing a run.  
[*] [FIX]: Changed "Monster Train" score to include even monsters that don't level up by default.
[*] [FIX]: Fixed an issue where the score values reset when loading an existing run (they are now stored in the save file).
[*] [FIX]: Fixed an issue where the "Mana Infusion" skill costs 0 in the shop. 
[*] [FIX]: Fixed an issue where cards ended up with similar discovery orders after using card removal in the shop.
[*] [FIX]: The game now uses the "Discovery order" to locate the card when leveling up instead of using the current position of the card in the UI. 
[*] [FIX]: Fixed an issue where the extra monster "Shadow Mask" wasn't healing the "Flame Wyrm" boss. 
[*] [UI]: Added score details in the codex UI.  
[*] [QOL]: The god mode level default value in the difficulty selection UI is now based on the last selected value.
[*] [QOL]: Player name can now be set in the title screen. 
[*] [QOL]: The name field during difficulty selection is now filled by default.
[*] [QOL]: The name during a run can now be empty/hidden in case you don't want to show your name. 
[*] [VISUAL]: Moved game version before starting a run to the top right of the screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Weekly Patch 1: First Progression Steps
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022620/70ffc74d519bd809e25fa4f65d482017305b33ac.png[/img]

There are many things missing from the game, and this patch is one of the first ones to address all of that. 

[h1]Warrior Class Unlock[/h1]
The warrior class is now locked and can only be unlocked by beating the first god with the assassin class. This adds progression without making it impossible for new players to unlock the new class.

[h1]Score System[/h1]
I added a score system that displays the result of how your run went. This is probably the feature that took most of this week's time. In future patches, the score amount will be used as experience points to unlock new cards/skills. 

[h1]Monster Codex Unlocks[/h1]
All the data related to monsters is now hidden by default. To reveal a monster's data, you need to defeat it at least once. This adds more progression to the game.

[h1]God Mode Levels (Difficulty)[/h1]
This is a work in progress, so for now I only added 3 levels and they are unlocked by default. In future patches, I will add more levels and make it so that you have to win runs to unlock them. 

[h1]Shop Monsters[/h1]
The monsters in the shop are now completely random. Only one shop specific monster is present and the rest is all about non-shop monsters. This adds more variety to runs since the cards you get from monsters in battle are always the same. The non-shop monsters don't include the starter monsters to make sure the options you get are more interesting.

[h1]Localization Issues With Asian Languages[/h1]
I finally managed to fix the font problems related to Chinese, Japanese and Korean. However, I need to keep updating certain things so it's still possible to have one or two characters missing. That being said, the current experience should be way better than before. 

[h1]Demo Removal[/h1]
With the current player count, it's very hard for me to justify updating both the main game and the demo. This is why I decided to remove the demo and only focus on the main game.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] [FIX]: Fixed an issue where you can preview cards from the warrior class even when it's locked.
[*] [FIX]: Removed wishlist button from settings. 
[*] [FIX]: Removed wishlist button from dialogue box when quitting the game. 
[*] [PROGRESSION]: The warrior class is now only unlocked after beating the first god with the assassin class. 
[*] [FEATURE]: Added a score system during the run, displayed when it ends.
[*] [FEATURE]: Monster info in codex is now locked by default. Monsters only show their info if they are defeated in battle.
[*] [FEATURE]: God mode levels are now accessible from the start by default (will be unlockable later). 
[*] [GAMEPLAY]: Added god mode level 1 (Gods no longer give cards).
[*] [GAMEPLAY]: Added god mode level 2 (player level is now capped at 30).
[*] [GAMEPLAY]: Added god mode level 3 (you can only unlock 15 skills per run).
[*] [GAMEPLAY]: The shop no longer shows the same monsters all the time. Now it's 5 random non-starter monsters + 1 shop only monster.
[*] [GAMEPLAY]: It's now possible to buy a monster card in shop even if you have a duplicate in your deck.
[*] [QOL]: The skill selection UI no longer shows in boss/god battles if all the skill slots are filled.
[*] [QOL]: The skills bar now hides if we check the cards in the deck during a run. 
[*] [VISUAL]: Arrows no longer hide cards when seeing your deck cards. 
[*] [VISUAL]: The "Unlock a skill" text after beating a boss isn't behind the skills bar anymore.
[*] [VISUAL]: The "SHOP" text after in the shop isn't behind the skills bar anymore.
[*] [LOCALIZATION]: Fixed font issues with Chinese (simplified).
[*] [LOCALIZATION]: Fixed font issues with Chinese (traditional).
[*] [LOCALIZATION]: Fixed font issues with Korean.
[*] [LOCALIZATION]: Fixed font issues with Japanese.
[*] [DEMO]: Removed the demo from the store page.
[/list]

notes.title: 2 Weeks Before Release!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022620/666e20ae90b97b65a8b4730a6f9558426431b9f9.png[/img]

With the early access coming soon (in 2 weeks), I am thinking about the last features I can add before release. 

[h3]1) New Monsters In Main Quest II/III:[/h3]
Adding new monsters in quest II and III. 10 new in each. Maybe add new bosses too if enough time. 

[h3]2) Score System:[/h3]
One common thing you find in roguelike games is a final screen with a lot of numbers when you finish a run, I need to add that instead of the demo end message. 

[h3]3) Credits:
[/h3]Even if I am a solo developer, I did buy some assets on the Unity store so the names will be linked there. This can also help in case someone is thinking I am using AI art lol.

[h3]4) Monster Duplicate: 
[/h3]In the recent patches, it became possible to meet the same monster multiple times in battles. What's lacking is a sort of a "fusion" mechanic that allows you to fuse the second copy with the first one instead of adding it. For example, instead of having Ice Crab x2, you sacrifice the new one to level up the first one, so your existing Ice Crab gets a level + 1. 

[h3]5) Achievements: 
[/h3]Needless to say, there has to be some achievements at launch. I am not 100% sure they will all be available at the start but I will try to add enough at the beginning and complete the rest later if needed. 

[h3]6) God Mode Levels: 
[/h3]This one is a bit tricky. Right now the game isn't difficult, this way, anyone can finish a run. I think it's better to do it this way to make the game more accessible. However, this is still a roguelike so it has to be hard. This is where the "God Mode" comes in. Now, I can make it similar to other deckbuilders where each run unlocks the next level. So if you win at God Mode level 0, you unlock level 1. Level 1 unlocks level 2, etc...

This might be a bit messy though if some of the difficulties have to change the order. For example level 2 is "limit skills to 15 slots" but it becomes the new level 5 because it's too difficult at the beginning. We will see how it goes.

[h3]7) No metaprogression, only content:
[/h3]The game doesn't have meta progression. This means that winning new runs only unlocks content, it doesn't make you stronger. So you can unlock new monsters, new skills, etc...Due to the amount of content currently available, I am not sure yet if I should lock of the current content, or wait until early access to add new content that will be locked by default. 

[h3]8) Beastiary:
[/h3]If you didn't notice already, I spent tons of time on tooltips, with a lot of text everywhere to make sure you don't need to Google anything (or at least keep it to a minimum). I am planning to add a sort of a Pokedex for the monsters so that you can see their moves and some extra info. However, this would make it too easy and wouldn't contribute to the progression. So I will do something like "FIght this monster 10 times to unlock his info/data". 

This is all I can think of right now. If things go well, I should be able to implement most of this before release. Let me know if you have other ideas. I may not be able to implement it right now but it'll be added to my backlog :D

See you on Discord,
NourSaiFR
